response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer with strong software craftsmanship, testing, and open-source community credentials, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The minimum bar of 8 years of C++ programming is not met — C/C++ appears only in a ~6-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis project, and C++ is absent from the listed skills. The experience base is predominantly web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, Ember, D), with limited evidence of large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, or production cloud compute platform architecture beyond one low-latency microservices role at Sociomantic. There is also no formal technical leadership or mentoring-of-cloud-engineers track record, despite 'Staff' titles. Not a fit for a C++-centric cloud compute platform technical lead.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering career across web, mobile, embedded, and backend
Strong testing/TDD culture, open-source tooling, and workshop/teaching experience
Some low-latency, high-throughput microservices exposure (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
concerns: Does not meet the 8-year C++ minimum (roughly 6 months of C/C++ work)
Little evidence of large-scale cloud compute or distributed infrastructure ownership
No demonstrated formal technical leadership or mentoring of cloud/DevOps engineers
